current_evidence: The council's 'What to submit with your planning application' page is the only validation page under 'Apply for planning permission'. It sets out the local requirements and links Grokbot's PDF as just one of two topic checklists; no formal local validation list was found on the site or by web search, and the page text shows no adoption date (metadata only, 30 Jun 2025).

issues.detail: Grokbot's 'Validation list URL' is the Biodiversity and Ecology compliance checklist for Core Strategy policies SS6 and LD2. This is a single-topic checklist, not Herefordshire's local validation requirements. The council's local requirements are set out on the 'What to submit with your planning application' page, which links this PDF as one of two optional-if-relevant checklists. A direct fetch of the PDF was blocked by robots.txt, so its contents could not be re-read.
issues.evidence: What to submit page: 'Biodiversity and ecology compliance checklist' - submit if relevant to your application (listed under 'Checklists' alongside the Climate change compliance checklist)

issues.detail: The List date 2020-11-01 is the PDF CreationDate of the biodiversity checklist, not the date of a local list. The current validation page shows no adoption or publication date in its text, so the 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' flag rests on the wrong document. The page was created and last modified on 30 Jun 2025 (metadata only).
issues.evidence: Page metadata created/modified 2025-06-30; no date in the page text

issues.detail: The Climate change compliance checklist (Core Strategy SS1/SD1) is missing. The council asks for it alongside the biodiversity checklist, to be submitted if relevant to the application.
issues.evidence: 'Climate change compliance checklist' (https://www.herefordshire.gov.uk/media/kxcca3ky/ss_sd1_climate_change_compliance_checklist.pdf) - submit if relevant

issues.detail: None of the council's local drawing and submission requirements are captured. The page requires a bar scale on all plans (the council is a paperless office); the paper size and scale stated for each plan (e.g. 1:50 at A1); a north point; a unique reference and date on each plan; documents not bound or stapled; one copy only; electronic submission only via the Planning Portal (no A0 electronically); either electronic or paper, not both; location plans on recent OS or equivalent mapping that is not Land Registry, not reused, shows Crown copyright and licence number, and is not a photocopy or screen grab; and no photographs of drawings.
issues.evidence: What to submit page, local requirements: 'Include a bar scale on all plans' ... 'Photographs of drawings are not accepted'

issues.detail: The only tab item is a garbled fragment pointing to HRA guidance, not a requirement.
issues.evidence: Tab item: 'Herefordshire Council's advice and local requirements, including HRA; sment_hra_guidance_note.pdf s/12'

issues.detail: The Ecological Survey row is tagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', while Householder and every other type show '(none)'. The council's checklists apply to any application where relevant, with no application-type restriction, so householder and other applications affecting biodiversity or climate-change policy can also need them.
issues.evidence: What to submit page: checklists to be submitted 'if relevant to your application' (no application types stated)

issues.detail: 'Photographs / Photomontages' is not a standalone requirement. Grokbot's own excerpt shows it is the evidence an applicant gives instead of an ecological survey to show there is no likely ecological impact, part of the same biodiversity checklist item.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'together with photographs and/ or other evidence clearly showing that there is no likely ecological impact.'

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' field is just the council homepage (https://www.herefordshire.gov.uk), not the validation page. The council's 'Common reasons why a planning application is invalid' PDF, linked from the validation page, was not in docs_read (and is robots-blocked to this check).
issues.evidence: Validation page links 'Common reasons why a planning application is invalid' (https://www.herefordshire.gov.uk/media/x3ynt2to/common_reasons_why_a_planning_application_is_invalid.pdf)

summary: Grokbot captured a single-topic Biodiversity and Ecology compliance checklist (dated by PDF metadata, 2020) instead of Herefordshire's validation guidance, which is the 'What to submit with your planning application' page with its local plan and drawing rules and two compliance checklists (climate change and biodiversity). Almost nothing local was captured, and the date and outdated flag are based on the wrong document.
